title: Don Quixote Suite
identity: Bryan Kelly, Don Quixote Suite (catalogued 1998), Emerson E353, soprano saxophone and piano (clarinet alternate also listed). Current edition details are retailer-derived; an institutional syllabus excerpt lists only movement 2, “Sancho Panza,” for Grade 5 soprano saxophone.

evidence.claim: Music retailer specifies Emerson Edition E353, soprano saxophone and piano, and publisher grade C/D.
A published university/exam syllabus includes Sancho Panza, movement 2, in an ABRSM Grade 5 soprano saxophone list.
British Music Collection describes Don Quixote as a suite for saxophone and piano.
Retailer search listing identifies Emerson E353 as soprano saxophone and piano, with a clarinet alternate, and labels skill level C/D; underlying product page returned a cache miss.
A University repository-hosted syllabus excerpt places “Sancho Panza,” the second movement, on a Grade 5 soprano saxophone list.

review_focus: Inference: compare the complete suite with the partial Grade 5 placement; the syllabus listing applies to one movement and cannot establish the whole suite’s demands.
collection_flag: Original saxophone suite with documented school-syllabus use of one movement. This does not establish simplification or exclude college use.
gaps: No opened publisher page, accessible score preview, saxophone recording, or college/professional performance was verified.
Retailer skill label is not used as a difficulty recommendation.
